bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atqc "SELECT 'room:'||room_id||':'||status||':revision='||revision FROM room_posts ORDER BY room_id DESC LIMIT 5; SELECT 'linked_announcements:'||count(*) FROM announcement_posts WHERE room_id IS NOT NULL; SELECT 'room_linked_deliveries:'||coalesce(status,'NULL')||':'||count(*) FROM posting_deliveries WHERE source_type='announcement' AND source_id IN (SELECT announcement_id::text FROM announcement_posts WHERE room_id IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY status ORDER BY status; SELECT 'app_decisions:'||status||':'||count(*) FROM announcement_applications GROUP BY status ORDER BY status;"
